title: Rook Takes an Interest
summary: Time with the Warrens children makes Rook curious about the player.

hooks.situation: The little ones keep coming back with the same story: {player} {event.summary}. Grown folk don't waste time on Warrens children unless they want something.

options.label: Send a runner to bring them to the back room

effects.text: Have a runner bring {player} to the back room under the cooper's, and find out what they want with your crew.

options.label: Tell them to keep away from your crew

effects.text: Tell {player} straight: the crew is yours, and anyone who uses them answers to you.

options.label: Work out what they're worth knowing

effects.text: Feel {player} out for what they're worth: who they work for, what they carry, who'd pay to know.

options.label: Say nothing; let the little ones keep watching
